subject: SIG workflow kick-off: hosting/residency and evidence routing
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: SIG workflow kick-off: hosting/residency and evidence routing

Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + asks so we have alignment on the SIG kickoff and next steps.

Call recap (high level):
- NovaMed is evaluating Redwood for patient-facing summarization features; main gating items are SOC 2 posture + HIPAA / data residency.
- You mentioned production data will be US-only for now and that you have a SOC 2 Type II report from earlier this year.
- You expect a security questionnaire (SIG or CAIQ) and some evidence items (network diagram, SOC cert, encryption notes).

My asks / questions to help scope:
1) Confirm SOC 2: can you confirm Type II and the report date (month/year)? If you can share the cert we can pre-populate the SIG where relevant.
2) Data residency: you said US-only; which cloud region(s) are your primary production systems hosted in (AWS us-east-1 / us-west-2 / other)?
3) PHI scope: please confirm whether NovaMed will provide any PHI to Redwood in the POC or only de-identified records.
4) Preferred questionnaire: do you want the standard SIG (recommended for detailed evidence) or a lighter CAIQ? We're happy to accept a custom form if you already have one.
5) Evidence drop: if you can share a small evidence pack (SOC cert, data flow diagram, encryption at rest/in transit statement) we can do a first-pass prefill and indicate gaps.

Attached is our quick SIG prefill template that speeds up mapping (redwood-sig-template.xlsx). If you prefer, we can run a 30-min screen share where we walk through the SIG and mark what we already have on file.

Suggested timeline (flexible):
- Day 0 (today): confirm preferred questionnaire and primary contacts for evidence.
- Week 1: NovaMed drops initial evidence; Redwood returns prefills + open questions.
- Week 2: clarifying Qs answered; we provide a gap list and estimate for BAA/contract items.

Let me know which questionnaire you prefer and whether your security team wants us to use a shared Drive or your Secure Upload portal for artifacts.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-sig-template.xlsx
From: Elena Morales <elena@novamed.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novamed.com, Paul Singh <paul.singh@cloudadvisors.io>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG workflow kick-off: hosting/residency and evidence routing

Thanks Stephanie — appreciate the clear recap. A few items inline: 

1) SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II (report period ended 2026-01). I'll attach the cert and send the full report via the secure folder. 
2) Hosting / residency: primary production is AWS us-east-1; backups to us-west-2. No EU hosting at this time.
3) PHI: for the POC we'll be sending limited PHI (patient identifiers + short notes). We understand this brings HIPAA requirements.
4) Questionnaire: prefer SIG (the buyer-side security team likes the granularity). We'll let you know if a CAIQ would be easier later.
5) Evidence drop: I'll start a folder in our vendor portal and also drop copies in the Drive link if that helps. Expect a first packet (SOC cert + network diagram + encryption statement) by EOD Wednesday.

Question for Redwood: do you require a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) before we move PHI for the POC? Our legal team flagged that as necessary for HIPAA-covered workflows.

I'll copy Paul (our external security advisor) who is coordinating evidence collection.

—Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Security Operations | NovaMed Health
elena.morales@novamed.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

Attachments: novamed-soc2-cert.pdf, data-flow-diagram.png
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novamed.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG workflow kick-off: hosting/residency and evidence routing

Thanks Elena — good to see the SOC cert timeline. A couple of technical clarifying questions from our infra/compliance side to speed up the prefill: 

- Encryption: do you have AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit across all data paths? If any systems differ, please call that out.
- Key management: are encryption keys customer-managed (KMS/HSM) or NovaMed-managed?
- Logging / retention: where are access logs stored and what is your default retention period for audit logs?
- PHI handling: for the POC, will NovaMed run the data through a pseudonymization step or send raw PHI? If pseudonymized, can you describe the mapping process (one-way vs reversible)?
- SSO / IdP: do you support SAML or OIDC for SSO? If yes, can you share metadata (or we'll list the requirements in the SIG).

If it's easier, we've attached a short guidance doc that explains the minimal pieces we need to prefill the SIG (sig-prefill-guidance.pdf). Our typical turnaround after an evidence drop + short answers is 3–5 business days for a first-pass prefilling.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Product Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Paul Singh <paul.singh@cloudadvisors.io>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG workflow kick-off: hosting/residency and evidence routing

Appreciate the quick responses, team — here's a short mutual action plan so everyone has clear next steps. I'm happy to adjust if NovaMed needs different sequencing.

Mutual action plan (dates tentative):
- By 2026-07-15 EOD: NovaMed to drop initial evidence (SOC cert, network diagram, encryption statement) to https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bSigDropzoneExample and copy security@novamed.com.
- By 2026-07-16: Redwood (Karthik/Grace) does a first-pass SIG prefill and returns open questions.
- By 2026-07-20: NovaMed answers open questions and confirms PHI handling approach for the POC.
- By 2026-07-23: Redwood provides gap list and BAA draft (if required) and a proposed remediation timeline for any major gaps.

On the BAA question: Redwood does sign BAAs for customers handling PHI. I'll loop in our legal lead if you confirm you need one; we can run a short approval path for POCs.

If helpful, I can set up a 30-minute screenshare tomorrow to walk through the SIG prefill and run through the items in sig-prefill-guidance.pdf. Proposed times: 9:30–10:00 PT or 1:30–2:00 PT. Please indicate a preference.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting the file started.

—Stephanie
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
